newsitem.title: JAPAN: Olympus to increase operations in Eastern Europe.
newsitem.headline: Olympus to increase operations in Eastern Europe.

text.p: Olympus Optical Co Ltd said on Wednesday that its subsidiaries in Poland, Hungary and Slovenia will start operations later this month.

Olympus Optical Polska Spzoo, formed in January 1997, and Olympus Hungary Kft, formed in November 1996, will market microscopes and endoscopes and offer technical services, the company said in a statement. Olympus Trgovina doo, the company's Slovenia unit formed in July 1996, will offer maintenance services.
"Along with existing subsidiaries in the Czech Republic and Croatia, the new units will expand and reinforce Olympus' marketing and service capabilities in Eastern Europe," Olympus said.
